Why this chapter matters

1. This chapter gives information about the experience and perceptions of people from various
ethnic minority groups. Whilst we cannot specifically address the particular issues each
individual ethnic minority group might experience (due to the vast diversity of England and
Wales), much of this guidance will generally be appropriate for individuals of various ethnic
minority backgrounds.
